answer: Weight each agent's vote and reward by the square root of its staked capital, not by account count. Split one treasury across 1,000 clones and total influence rises only ~31x (sqrt of 1,000), never 1,000x, so the payoff curve bends inward like a tightening spiral. Doubling real sway requires 4x the locked stake, leaving a sybil farm as dead weight: each fake sits as inert as a relic fossil pressed into shale. Concentrated honest stake always outvotes dispersed clones.
